semiconductor_relevance: High — Pibond Oy specializes in advanced electronic materials critical for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly for next-generation devices.
summary: Pibond Oy Taiwan Branch manufactures a diverse range of electronic materials tailored to meet stringent performance requirements in the semiconductor industry. Their products, including advanced siloxane and metal oxide monomers and polymers, are utilized in the production of cutting-edge semiconductor devices and MEMS packaging.
capabilities: Advanced siloxane and metal oxide monomers and polymers
Materials for 10 nm class semiconductor devices

regional_presence.Taiwan: Pibond Oy has a branch in Taiwan, supplying materials to leading foundries in the region.
